meta.name: prompt-engineering
meta.description: Master prompt engineering for AI models: LLMs, image generators, video models. Techniques: chain-of-thought, few-shot, system prompts, negative prompts. Models: Claude, GPT-4, Gemini, FLUX, Veo, Stable Diffusion prompting. Use for: better AI outputs, consistent results, complex tasks, optimization. Triggers: prompt engineering, how to prompt, better prompts, prompt tips, prompting guide, llm prompting, image prompt, ai prompting, prompt optimization, prompt template, prompt structure, effective prompts, prompt techniques

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化提示词以获得更准确的AI输出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常与AI模型交互并希望获得更可靠的结果。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize prompts for more accurate AI outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently interact with AI models and want more reliable results.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你提供的提示工程技巧（如角色设定、思维链、少样本示例等）生成更精准的文本、图像或视频输出。
howto.when: 当你询问如何编写提示词、优化 AI 输出，或要求使用特定提示技巧（如思维链、少样本示例）时触发。

say.text: 用角色提示法，以资深数据科学家身份解释梯度下降。
say.note: Claude 会扮演该角色，用简单类比解释。

say.text: 用思维链逐步解决这个数学问题：商店苹果2元，橙子3元，买5个花12元，各几个？
say.note: Claude 会分步推理后给出答案。

say.text: 用少样本示例将句子转为正式商务英语。
say.note: Claude 会参考你给的例子进行转换。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate more precise text, image, or video outputs based on prompt engineering techniques you provide (e.g., role prompting, chain-of-thought, few-shot examples).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask how to write prompts, optimize AI outputs, or request specific prompt techniques (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot).

say_en.text: Use role prompting to explain gradient descent as a senior data scientist.
say_en.note: Claude will adopt that role and explain with simple analogies.

say_en.text: Solve this math problem step by step: apples $2, oranges $3, 5 fruits for $12, how many each?
say_en.note: Claude will reason step by step before giving the answer.

say_en.text: Use few-shot examples to convert sentences to formal business English.
say_en.note: Claude will follow your examples to perform the conversion.
